name: Williston Woodworks
old_description: Locally-crafted custom cabinetry has been our passion since 1952!
about:
Williston Woodworks was founded in 1952 in Williston, North Dakota, before Second Avenue West was paved. The company incorporated in 1955, initially producing residential cabinets and wooden boats for the newly formed Lake Sakakawea. In 1964, the growing business moved to a larger facility on Second Avenue, and in 1983 it relocated to its current 15,000-square-foot shop West.

The firm designs, manufactures, and installs custom kitchen, bath, and specialty cabinetry, along with countertops and custom stairways. Its full-service process covers measuring, detailed space layout, fabrication, delivery, and professional installation. The shop serves both residential and commercial clients, producing custom casework for banks, hospitals, nursing homes, and office complexes.

Williston Woodworks coordinates with local builders, electricians, and plumbers to manage entire project scopes, from new construction to renovations. The company's commercial portfolio includes numerous healthcare and financial institutions in the region, while its residential work spans custom kitchens, baths, and living spaces.

The business emphasizes a blend of original craftsmanship methods and modern equipment, with a knowledgeable staff that prioritizes quality and service from initial contact through project completion.

old_description: Wilmington Precision Machining custom designs and manufactures End Forming & Bending Tools per customer specifications. Including tools for Beading, Flaring, Reducing and Notching.
about:
Wilmington Precision Machining was founded in 1996 in Wilmington, Ohio. The company began with a focus on customer service and has grown to meet evolving customer needs.

The shop custom designs and manufactures end forming and bending tools to customer specifications, including tools for beading, flaring, reducing, and notching. Its capabilities also encompass tube trim and cut‑off, gage and fixture design, special machines and automation, blanking and progressive stamping dies, consumable tooling, prototyping services, and special machining. A full‑time engineering staff uses solid modeling to ensure accuracy across prototype and production runs.

While the company does not publicly list specific industry verticals, its tooling supports manufacturers in sectors that require precision formed metal components.

The business was established with customer service as a guiding principle, and it continues to promote accuracy as its defining characteristic, supported by an in‑house engineering team focused on solid modeling for guaranteed precision.

name: Windsor Chairmakers
old_description: Come visit our shop and showroom and experience it for yourself.
about:
Windsor Chairmakers has been hand-crafting fine furniture in Lincolnville, Maine, since 1987. Owners Mike and Jana Timchak operate the business from a campus that includes two 1840s farmhouses serving as an 18-room showroom and a converted barn workshop where traditional joinery techniques are practiced daily.

The shop produces Windsor chairs, Shaker-style furniture, dining tables, beds, desks, benches, and custom pieces, all built to order from native New England woods such as tiger maple, cherry, white ash, black walnut, and pine. Each piece receives a multi-layer, environmentally friendly finish topped with a hand-rubbed beeswax coat, and chair joints are reinforced with epoxy for added durability.

The company serves residential customers directly, offering a custom design service that begins with a scale drawing based on the client’s ideas. Their lifetime guarantee covers workmanship and wood failure for the original owner, with repair provided at no charge beyond shipping.

Windsor Chairmakers distinguishes itself by creating original Windsor designs that blend 18th-century aesthetics with contemporary ergonomics, rather than reproducing antiques. The founders emphasize doing things right the first time, a philosophy reflected in the guarantee and the use of solid wood without veneers or manufactured substrates.

name: Wire Crafters Inc
old_description: . We started by concentrating our efforts on one product and developed a partition system that has since changed the industry.
about:
Wire Crafters Inc. was founded in 1967 in Sparks, Nevada, and has remained a family-owned business under the Diebold family since its inception. The company began by focusing on a single product and developed a wire partition system that transformed the industry.

Today, Wire Crafters manufactures woven and welded wire partition systems at its Louisville, Kentucky facility using domestically sourced raw materials. Its product line includes the Style 840 wire partition system, RapidWire™ welded wire partitions, tenant storage lockers, guard rail and handrail systems, and enclosures for machine guarding, robotic work cells, pallet rack backing, vertical lifts, and DEA-approved pharmaceutical storage. The company operates laser cutting equipment, a robotic post welder, and a powder coat finishing line stocked in eight colors, enabling a modular panel system that supports 48-hour shipping on most stock orders.

Wire Crafters serves the material handling and automation safety sectors, with installations in warehouses, manufacturing plants, and pharmaceutical facilities. Its partitions are used for tool cribs, secured storage areas, maintenance cages, and physical barriers for robotic work cells.

The company emphasizes its family ownership, U.S.-based manufacturing, and the simplicity and strength of its Style 840 system as core differentiators. RapidWire™ was developed specifically for quick ship times and fast installation, reflecting a focus on reducing lead times for customers.

about:
Wire Specialists Inc operates from Brookfield, Wisconsin, where it was founded in April 1990 by owners John and Charlie. The company began as a service-oriented wire EDM job shop focused on the tool and die industry.

The shop provides wire EDM cutting, EDM hole drilling, CNC machining, and grinding. Its equipment supports 5-axis wire EDM with a maximum workpiece travel of 26.5 inches in thickness and 30 by 31 inches in XY travel. The facility runs flexible hours to meet tight deadlines.

Wire Specialists serves primarily the tool and die industry, delivering precision components for die makers and mold builders. The company is a member of the Tool, Die, and Machining Association of Wisconsin.

The founders emphasize that having owners John and Charlie on the job daily ensures special attention to each project. They cite state-of-the-art EDM technology, dedicated skilled associates, and strong customer relationships as keys to reliable service and quick turnaround.

name: Wire Specialties
old_description: Welcome to Wire Specialties! We are the North American distributors for Furukawa Electric. We supply triple-insulated winding wires for power supplies and transformers. Our office is located in Amherst, New Hampshire and our wires are shipped from our warehouse in Atlanta, Georgia.
about:
Wire Specialties operates as the North American distributor for Furukawa Electric, supplying triple-insulated winding wires for power supply and transformer applications. The company maintains its office in Amherst, New Hampshire, while its inventory ships from a warehouse in Atlanta, Georgia.

The firm’s product line centers on TEX-E triple-insulated winding wire, which is designed for compact transformer and power supply designs. The wire eliminates the need for margin or interlayer tapes, allowing engineers to reduce component volume by up to 50% and weight by up to 65% compared to conventional constructions. Wire Specialties does not manufacture the wire itself but manages distribution and technical support for the Furukawa product range.

Customers include manufacturers of power supplies, transformers, and related electronic equipment that require high-voltage insulation in a small footprint. The company serves original equipment manufacturers and contract assemblers across North America.

Wire Specialties positions its value on providing a single-source supply for Furukawa’s TEX-E wire, enabling design engineers to achieve significant space and weight savings without additional insulation layers.

about:
Wire Wire Electric Supply, LLC operates from Toledo, Illinois, where President Tim Grissom leads a business built on 40 years of electrical industry experience. The company was established to provide a dependable supply of cable and wire to customers across the Lower 48 states, shipping from a central Illinois location.

The company functions as a distributor, sourcing from multiple wire manufacturers to stock a broad range of products including NM-B residential wire, UF-B direct burial cable, THHN/THWN-2 conduit wire, and flexible portable cords such as SOOW and SJOOW rubber cord. Orders over $100 and under 109 pounds ship free to the contiguous United States, while bulk orders are handled through custom quotes.

Its customer base spans the electrical industry, serving contractors, builders, and maintenance teams who need reliable access to copper wire and cable for residential, commercial, and industrial projects. The product catalog also includes specialized categories such as mining cable, medium voltage cable, and security and fire alarm wire.

Grissom emphasizes that the company does not aim to be the largest supplier but rather to maintain the highest standards of quality and service, leveraging long-standing relationships with wire mills to ensure competitive pricing and consistent availability.

name: WireFox Electric
old_description: Wirefox Electric has served thousands of homes in the Odenton, MD area with electrician services since 2018. We offer up-front pricing with affordable rates for all our customers and offer an exclusive satisfaction guarantee!
about:
WireFox Electric is an electrical services company based in Odenton, Maryland. Founded in 2018, the business is a family-owned operation whose owners have served the Odenton area for five generations. The company began as a local provider of residential and commercial electrical solutions, emphasizing up-front pricing and a satisfaction guarantee.

The company provides a range of electrical services including repairs, installations, and upgrades. Its offerings cover electrical wiring repairs, switch and outlet repairs, lighting and ceiling fan installations, EV charger installations, electrical panel upgrades, whole-home surge protection, and emergency electrical services. WireFox operates with licensed electricians available 24/7 and offers same-day service for urgent needs. The team serves thousands of homes across Odenton and surrounding communities such as Bowie, Columbia, Crofton, and Elkridge.

WireFox serves both residential homeowners and commercial clients. Typical projects include troubleshooting electrical issues, upgrading circuit breaker panels, installing EV charging stations, and performing electrical inspections for safety and efficiency. The company’s service area extends throughout Anne Arundel County and parts of Howard County, catering to property owners, property managers, and small businesses.

WireFox differentiates itself through transparent, up-front pricing, a satisfaction guarantee, and rapid response times. The company highlights its five-generation local heritage, 24/7 emergency availability, and same-day service as key reasons customers choose them. All work is performed by licensed technicians who prioritize safety and cleanliness.

about:
Wired Technologies was founded in 2017 as a privately held company in Livonia, Michigan. The business brought together a team with over 50 years of combined experience in electronics assembly, focusing on printed circuit board and wire harness manufacturing for a range of industrial sectors.

The company operates a 3,500-square-foot facility where it provides full-service electronics assembly, including surface-mount and through-hole PCB assembly, wire harness and cable loom fabrication, box build, electro-mechanical sub-assembly, conformal coating, potting, and underfill. It supports programs from prototype through production volumes, offering design, programming, functional testing, reverse engineering, and in-field support alongside turnkey material procurement.

Wired Technologies serves OEMs, Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers, and startups across industrial, heavy construction equipment, automotive, aerospace, medical, battery, marine, motorsports, and military markets. Customer testimonials reference vehicle harnesses for rugged outdoor validation, circuit boards for new designs, environmental testing harnesses, and calibration harnesses.

The company emphasizes a single-source model with a price-beat guarantee, 24-hour expedited turnaround, a two-week standard lead time, pick-up and drop-off logistics, and a 60-day workmanship warranty. It positions itself as an IPC-certified partner that manages the entire project lifecycle from concept to delivery.

name: Wires R Us Inc.
old_description: Yes. Wires R Us has been serving the Black Hills since 1999 and is now a second-generation electrical contractor. Our work is fully licensed, code-compliant, and built to pass inspections without surprises. We regularly work across Rapid City, Spearfish, Sturgis, Belle Fourche, Hot Springs, Hermosa, Black Hawk, and surrounding communities.
about:
Wires R Us Inc. is an electrical contractor based in Piedmont, South Dakota, serving the Black Hills region since 1999. The company was founded by Donahue Williamson, who started the business with a van and his nephew to create stability for his growing family. Now a second-generation family-owned operation, it continues to operate on the core values of efficiency, cleanliness, reliability, and craftsmanship established at its inception.

The firm specializes in residential new construction and multi-family electrical wiring, handling projects from rough-in to finish with a focus on clean, organized job sites. Its service portfolio includes electrical service upgrades (100A, 200A, 400A), panel swaps, lighting upgrades, EV charger installations, standby generator installation and maintenance, and hot tub wiring. A distinctive offering is 3D-mapped wiring, where every wire is scanned and logged for future reference. The company also takes on select commercial projects.

Primary customers are tract home builders, developers, and general contractors who require consistent scheduling and code-compliant work across the Black Hills, including Rapid City, Spearfish, Sturgis, Belle Fourche, Hot Springs, and surrounding communities. The company also serves homeowners for specific installations such as EV chargers, service upgrades, and generator systems, and works with vacation rental property owners in areas like Deadwood and Lead to install automatic standby generators.

Williamson launched the business after identifying a need for a reliable electrical contractor that showed up on time, communicated well, and took pride in doing things the right way. The company emphasizes making projects run smoother for general contractors through organized systems that reduce mistakes, speed timelines, and eliminate coordination headaches. Its core values—leaving job sites clean, showing up on schedule, and delivering quality efficient work—are cited as the reason builders maintain long-term relationships.
